parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale addresses all three error targets: (1) it removes the factual error that authors can easily identify the relevant section, noting that no section/table/figure is pinpointed; (2) it corrects the rubric misapplication about explicit mention of a paper part, treating it as a general design choice without a identifiable location; and (3) it removes the unsupported inference about easy identification. The final mapping language ('mid-level grounding/specificity rating rather than a fully grounded one') preserves the rubric connection without directly stating a numeric score or gold label. Unrelated correct reasoning about the comment specifying what needs to be addressed is preserved. The rationale is coherent and ready for insertion.
